verdict.rationale: Bench's own site carries a customer testimonial that the team "transitioned my books" and says most clients switched from DIY accounting software, which suggests a human-led migration service. Nothing documents how historical data is imported or that transaction-level detail is preserved. Catch-up bookkeeping and working inside an existing QBO account are adjacent services, not migration, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a documented migration/import process from other accounting systems, an explicit guarantee that historical transaction detail is preserved, supported source systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can migrate historical books from another accounting system without losing transaction detail

citations.quote: They transitioned my books and gave me real-time financial visibility.
80% of Bench clients switched from DIY accounting software.
